The season started on 22 August 2026 and is scheduled to conclude on 30 May 2027.{{cite news |title=Serie A 2026-27, si parte il 23 agosto. E ci sono anche le date della Supercoppa |url=https://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Serie-A/24-10-2025/serie-a-2026-27-le-date-della-stagione.shtml |date=25 October 2025 |publisher=Gazzetta dello Sport |language=it}} [[Inter Milan|Inter]] are the defending champions, having won their 21st title (''[[scudetto]]'') the previous season.{{Cite news |date=3 May 2026 |title=Inter cruise to Serie A title triumph after Thuram sparks victory over Parma |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/may/03/inter-win-serie-a-title-parma-football-italy |access-date=3 May 2026 |work=The Guardian |issn=0261-3077}} == Teams == Twenty teams are competing, including the top seventeen teams from the previous season and three promoted teams from [[2025–26 Serie B|Serie B]]. [[Venezia FC|Venezia]], [[Frosinone Calcio|Frosinone]] and [[AC Monza|Monza]] return to the top tier after one-, two- and one-year absences, respectively. They will replace [[US Cremonese|Cremonese]], [[Hellas Verona FC|Hellas Verona]] and [[Pisa SC|Pisa]], who were relegated to [[2026–27 Serie B|Serie B]] after one, seven and one year in the top flight, respectively. === Team changes === {| class="wikitable" !Promoted from
